graph.num_vertices: <int> Total number of vertices in the perfect graph.
graph.num_edges: <int> Total number of edges in the perfect graph.
graph.edges: <list[list[int]], shape [num_edges][2]> Each edge defined by its two endpoint vertices, with the smaller vertex index listed first.

partition.num_clusters: <int> Number of disjoint clusters into which the vertices are partitioned.
partition.clusters: <list[list[int]], length num_clusters> Vertex indices belonging to each cluster, where every vertex appears in exactly one cluster.
